### Summary

The directory `tests/vulcan/` holds a converted reaction network (`cho_photo.yaml`), the directory `cho/`, scripts
that convert networks (`tools/`) and a Chapman comparison script (`chapman/run_comparison.py`). Its entry
`photo_cross` is a symbolic link to `VULCAN/thermo/photo_cross`, a path that is not in the repository, so the link is
dangling in a fresh clone. No `ctest` entry runs them:
{{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}} registers only the C++ tests named by `setup_test` and the `test*.py` files at the
top of `tests/`, not files in subdirectories. So the comparison runs only when a user starts its script.
